why: What the fork (the Wan2GP line HocusPocus carries) does not publish: how it names a key per model family, and what it fetches at start and at model load (`ffmpeg`, `companions`). The shared helpers apply these rules and name no family themselves. The only file, with upstream.facts.json, where an engine key family or a model name may appear.

ffmpeg.why: shared/ffmpeg_setup.py download_ffmpeg (run at session start, shared/api.py:878) returns at once when ffmpeg and ffprobe resolve in <root>/ffmpeg_bins, <root> or on PATH and a copy in ffmpeg_bins has its libavdevice beside it; else it tries a download.

companions.why: wgp.py download_models(file_type=0), run at every model load (wgp.py:4326): its shared list (wgp.py:3912-3924, `shared` + `by_config`), the mask tool's (`calls.mask`, wgp.py:3927) and download_mmaudio's set (`audio` + the weight `calls.audio` names) when the config enables it, each [folder, files] under a checkpoint folder.
